sources.title: GitHub - Abhigyan1805/qwen-reasoning-distill: Pre-registered, compute ...
sources.snippet: A compute-matched, pre-registered study of post-training on Qwen3.5-2B, run entirely on free Kaggle T4 GPUs. Each pre-registered post-training arm (SFT distillation from a larger teacher, then GRPO and follow-ups) gets the same compute budget, and every arm is compared with the untouched base model under one identical evaluation harness.

sources.snippet: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill family (six variants from Qwen 1.5B through Llama 70B) is the most-deployed distillation lineage on Hugging Face with cumulative downloads in the tens of millions, transferring frontier reasoning quality into consumer-hardware-deployable sizes.
